description: Registered NeuroFlow extension namespaces. To register a new namespace, open a pull request to neuroflow-spec adding its schema file here and an entry below; maintainers act as registrar (cf. the NIfTI extension-code registry). See specification Section 28 and extensions/README.md.

extensions.title: NiiVue designer UI metadata
extensions.description: Designer-palette block, menu, form, and workflow-stage metadata for tools and workflows.

extensions.title: NiiVue declarative CLI execution
extensions.description: Declarative command-line execution (exec) metadata for console tools.

extensions.title: BIDS role and modality profile
extensions.description: Declares BIDS-App role and modality coverage for a tool or workflow.

extensions.title: NeuroVue review artifacts
extensions.description: Viewer-specific review artifacts produced by NeuroVue, including the correction-patch type.

extensions.title: NeuroFlow MCP binding
extensions.description: Per-document metadata for exposing tools and workflows to AI agents through a NeuroFlow MCP server: tool naming, annotations, wait budget, value types, and MCP App declarations. See RFC 0009.
